## §7-B3/B4 spot verification (10 sessions per asset)

- level prices independently recomputed from the m0 receipts: **3193/3193 pass** (`artifacts/cache/port/m1/spotcheck/spotcheck_levels.tsv`)
- profile objects vs a brute-force UNSMOOTHED histogram: **120/120 pass** (`artifacts/cache/port/m1/spotcheck/spotcheck_profiles.tsv`)

The profile check re-accumulates the histogram with a plain dict from the receipt trade arrays, asserts bin-for-bin equality, re-derives the POC from an independently convolved profile, and asserts the value area both brackets the POC and is MINIMAL at 70% (dropping either end must break the threshold).
